Contemporary Interior Door Levers

The contemporary design and easy installation of this straight door lever, will not disappoint those looking for a simple cheap leverset that will improve the look of any space. It fits any standard 2-1/8 inch bore hole door preparation. This leverset will fit 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" door thicknesses with an adjustable backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4". This door lever is available in all interior functions (single dummy, passage and privacy) with a Satin Nickel finish.

Features of Canaropa Straight Contemporary Lever:

  • Easy to install, this door lever fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • ANSI rated grade 3
  • Square corner latch faceplate
  • Radius corner strike plate
  • Non-handed, field reversible lever.

Specifications of the Canaropa Straight Contemporary Lever:

  • Overall Lever Length: 4-1/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Screw Hole Spacing: 1-5/8"
  • Spindle Length: 2"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: Adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

When selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: A surfaced mounted, non-working, smooth lever. Non-locking and non-latching trim for one side of door. This inactive lever is usually used to match trim. Complete Set - 1 lever and 1 rose.
  • Passage (hall or closet): Latches but does not lock. The latch is activated by turning the either of the two levers. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch and strike plate
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): Latches and can be locked for privacy. Can be locked from the inside with a finger turn located in the middle of the lever. In an emergency, it can unlock from the exterior using a coin or a screwdriver. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch and strike plate.
